Purdue University – College of Liberal Arts Research Academy (CLARA)

Position: Postdoctoral Research Assistant (full-time) Area: AI, Decision Making, and Risk Start Date: August 12, 2026 (academic year appointment, 9 months; 1-year term)

The College of Liberal Arts Research Academy (CLARA) at Purdue University invites applications for a Postdoctoral position focused on social-scientific questions at the intersection of AI, decision making, and risk. Research topics include human-AI decision making, large language models, and modeling of information processing and decision behavior.

Application materials:

• Cover letter
• CV
• 1–3 representative manuscripts
• Names and contact information for at least two references

Priority deadline: March 31, 2026 (applications will be reviewed until the position is filled)

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

Apply online via Purdue Careers:

(Req ID: 41135)

Questions may be directed to:
Professor Torsten Reimer Director, College of Liberal Arts Research Academy (CLARA)
